note: Public synthetic Q19 briefs (SPEC 'Generated-artifact evaluation'). Each oracle is deterministic and is checked against the app's saved records, never against model prose.

briefs.prompt: Build a trip tracker for a two-week trip. Tasks have a title, due date, status and optional blocking task. Show what to do next and why a task is blocked.
briefs.edit: Add a packing checklist grouped by bag, saved with the trip.

briefs.prompt: Build an RSS reading desk that refreshes a public feed source and lets me mark items read and save favourites.
briefs.edit: Add a per-source unread count and a filter for saved items.

briefs.prompt: Build a spending visualization from a pasted CSV of transactions with date, category and amount. Show totals by category and by month, including refunds.
briefs.edit: Add a monthly budget per category and highlight overspending.

briefs.prompt: Build a memory card game with a saved best score per board size.
briefs.edit: Add a timed mode with its own best score.

briefs.prompt: Build a reader for a long Markdown document with a table of contents, saved reading position and highlights.
briefs.edit: Add notes attached to highlights and an export of highlights.

briefs.prompt: Build a weather board for three saved places that refreshes forecasts and shows the next 24 hours.
briefs.edit: Add a rain warning when any place has more than 60 percent precipitation in the next 6 hours.
